extraction.Name: Jesse Ellston (also known as Jasper Ellston, Jasper J. Ellston, Jay Ellston)
extraction.Refused/Protested: Did you ask for that patent? No. Did you make any protest about the patent? No.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: When was it foreclosed? Two or three years ago.
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered by policeman from the Ponca station at the Bank of Herrick. Allottee states: 'I think they used poor judgment in giving me this patent as I did not care for it like I should.' Also known as Jasper Ellston, Jasper J. Ellston, and Jay Ellston. Has two children. Got a $1500 loan on the place. States no one took advantage of him to have him mortgage the place. Document number references: 245x 241. Notarized May 1, 1929 by Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32.
